title: 10 Euro Cents (1st map; coarse reeding)

composition.text: Nordic gold (89% Copper, 5% Aluminium, 5% Zinc, 1% Tin)

obverse.description: A modern adaptation of the Sower, initially designed by Oscar Roty, representing "France, which stays true to itself, whilst integrating into Europe", is encircled by the twelve stars of Europe
obverse.lettering: RF 2001 L. JORIO d'ap. O. ROTY
obverse.unabridged_legend:
République française
Laurent Jorio d'après Oscar Roty

reverse.description: A map, next to the face value, symbolizes the gathering of the 15 nations of the European Union

comments:
Gad# 4 has the description Grande Semeuse (large sower) and the type is coins issued 1999.
Gad# 4a has the description Petite Semeuse Iem type (small sower first type) and is coins issued 2000 to 2006.

Different Mint Master Marks
 

  • Pierre Rodier, from 1999 to 2000, a mark of a bee
     
  • Gerard Buquoy, from 2001 to 2002, a mark of a horseshoe
     
  • Serge Levet, in 2003, a mark of a stylised heart with the initials of the mint master (SL)
     
  • Hubert Lariviere, from 2004 to 2006, a mark of a hunting horn with a wave and a fish
